description: The plot illustrates the relationship between the number of epochs and the Word Error Rate (WER) for different fine-tuning methods of the Whisper model, specifically for the "tiny" model type. The x-axis represents the epoch, with a linear scale, ranging from 0 to 6, and tick labels at intervals of 1. The y-axis represents the WER, with a linear scale, ranging from 30 to 70, and tick labels at intervals of 10. The plot displays five lines, each representing a different fine-tuning method: tiny AdaLoRA_int4 (dark gray, circle markers, solid line), tiny AdaLoRA_int8 (light gray, circle markers, solid line), tiny int4 (dark gray, square markers, dashed line), tiny int8 (light gray, square markers, dashed line), and tiny full (light gray, triangle markers, dotted line). The tiny AdaLoRA_int4 line starts at a WER of approximately 70 at epoch 0 and decreases to around 51 at epoch 6, with a notable drop between epochs 0 and 1. The tiny AdaLoRA_int8 line begins at a WER of around 60 at epoch 0 and decreases to approximately 50 at epoch 6. The tiny int4 line starts at a WER of about 63 at epoch 0 and decreases to around 50 at epoch 6. The tiny int8 line begins at a WER of approximately 68 at epoch 0 and decreases to around 54 at epoch 6. The tiny full line remains relatively stable, starting at a WER of around 30 at epoch 0 and increasing slightly to approximately 33 at epoch 6.
